images.description: RoomEscapes.es listing page for the "Space monkey" escape room in Granollers, desktop 1440 (third-party ranking site, dark neon UI, not the room's own site). Monkey-astronaut cover image, rating 7.25/10, quick facts (2-6 players, price 60-96, Granollers, theme "aventuras") and the story text "Habeis conseguido graduaros con honores en la academia..." (Lt./Col. John Tyler, station Helios, shuttle Icarus). Street address is masked.
RoomEscapes.es listing for "Space monkey", desktop, first screen at 2x (street address masked).
RoomEscapes.es listing for "Space monkey", mobile 390: header, title, facts chips and the cover image.
RoomEscapes.es listing for "Space monkey", mobile: story text and the Reservar button.

Space Monkey logo/cover art as published on RoomEscapes.es: monkey astronaut with headset and helmet on a dark starry background with dashed orbit lines. Low resolution (650x494 JPG); the room's own site (monkeyroomescape.es) is offline and its archived copies have no images. Author of this artwork: UNKNOWN (not confirmed to be Pau).

note: Captured 2026-10-28. The room's own website monkeyroomescape.es no longer resolves; Internet Archive snapshots (2019-2022) render unstyled or blank and have no images, so they were used for text only. Desktop images 1440 px wide (1x), mobile 780 px wide (390 css px at 2x).
